text: Request: summarize the attached report in five bullets. Exactly one report is attached.
Request: transfer the agreed amount to the usual account. Neither the amount nor account is supplied in available context.
Request: send it to Alex. Two different documents and two contacts named Alex are present.
Request: convert temperatures to Celsius. Every value is explicitly marked Fahrenheit.
Request: book the cheaper flight. Two flights have equal prices but different airports and dates.
Request: delete the old database. There are two databases and neither is identified as old.
Request: create a read-only summary of all three listed files; no external action is requested.
Request: rename draft.txt to notes.txt in this folder. draft.txt exists and notes.txt does not.
